result: The inherited expanding parent supplies a finite all-wavelength linear growth budget; an earlier supplied mode identifies a nonlinear formation window.

elementary_all_wavelength_bound.explanation: |delta(t)| <= exp[D ui^3/(12 Hmin^2)] |delta_i| for zero initial current, in the linear envelope at every k. A loose early-time bound may overflow; use the exact positive dust comparison instead.

necessary_linear_seed_thresholds.interpretation: Necessary linear extrapolation thresholds, not sufficient nonlinear collapse conditions. Initial velocity parameter is delta_dot/H.

earlier_conditional_window.scope: Single local mode on the earlier averaged-parent continuation. Delta=1 is beyond linear validity and only identifies where a nonlinear continuation is needed. No shared-wall past or thermal history has been constructed.

compact_seed.definition: g(r)=(1-r^2/L^2)^4_+; delta_i=-Laplacian(g*g) normalized to peak .05; zero phase/current. L is the preceding initial reservoir radius in comoving atlas units. Support 2L, exact zero monopole and nonnegative Fourier density weight.
compact_seed.scope: An explicitly supplied small compact disturbance, not an inherited stochastic seed law or a formed core. Spectral tail bound applies throughout the linear envelope future. Delta=1 only marks failure of linear extrapolation.

limits: Linear local envelope modes on the declared averaged parent, no installed nonlinear core.
